Modern common use is an editorial preference supported by source alternatives and a subtitle frequency corpus, not a native-speaker certification. Asian English glosses are dictionary definitions, not independently attested English entries; long definition-only, grammar-only and unresolved-reference records are excluded. Unchanged records passed structural screening, not exhaustive native semantic verification. No missing-language translation is filled automatically.
